title: The Uncharted Wreck
author: S. M. Reyes
blurb: Ada Galloway, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
